jd.title: Platform Engineer (DevOps)
jd.external_text:
Kestrel Pay processes card and SEPA payments for about 900 European merchants. Everything runs in AWS eu-west-1 inside a PCI-DSS scope we have to defend every year. We are adding a fourth engineer to a team of three. Amsterdam, hybrid, three days a week in our Zuidas office.

What you'll do
- Own our Terraform modules and the Kubernetes clusters (EKS) that the thirty-odd payment services run on.
- Take our deploy pipeline from 40 minutes to under 10. The tests are the bottleneck, not the build.
- Share the on-call rota with the rest of the team: one week in four, roughly two pages a month.
- Sit with the security engineers through the annual PCI audit and own the evidence we hand the assessor.

Requirements
- 4+ years running production Kubernetes, not just kubectl apply.
- Terraform at module level, with a real opinion about state layout.
- You can debug a Linux networking problem without reaching for a rebuild.
- Payments or another regulated environment, so that you understand why a change window exists.

Nice to have
- Postgres operations: replication, failover and the boring parts of backup testing.
- Datadog, which is what we page from.

You would report to the CTO. It is a genuinely fast-paced environment - we deploy most days and change control is real, so both of those are true at once. Salary €70,000 - €88,000 plus equity.
